title: Increased phenanthrene toxicity to Eisenia fetida upon co-exposure to o-xylene
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00726C, Paper
Guofeng Li, Zhongran Wu, Haifeng Chi, Shanna Lin, Chao Cai
Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) and benzene, toluene, ethylbenzene, and xylene (BTEX) are common soil pollutants known to be toxic to ecosystems, but their combined environmental risks and ecological effects remain poorly understood.
